title: Kallio street underlay — corridors that carry public transport

source.isNot: NOT A STREET MAP. These are the corridors along which HSL runs service, which in Kallio covers most of the grid that matters but omits every street with no route on it — Torkkelinkatu, Agricolankatu, Wallininkatu and most of the quiet Torkkelinmäki blocks are simply absent. Do not present it as a basemap. A real one is one Overpass query from a machine that can reach the internet; see TRANSIT_LAYERS.md §10.8.
source.weightMeans: trips = GTFS trips per week over that corridor, summed across every route that uses it. Brightness driven by this makes a trunk look like a trunk without anyone hand-classifying a road.
